I am a little frustrated because within this 60 page rulebook there is no mentioning of “nest” or “breeding”, at least the search in the PDF document finds nothing Image: 😒

Aug 13, 2022Full Date

The information you are looking is on the minion AI cards for Nests and Venom. Do you have the minions set? I don't remember if the AI card came in that package or it is in the regular monster AI card deck.
It is pretty self explanatory on those AI cards. I'm sure if you find them, you will understand.

Aug 13, 2022 (edited) Full Date

Rulebook 16.Minions, page 58. There is the sample of the card: Nest Minion.
Spawn one nest means:
- if there are at least one open Spawn Gate, you have to spawn there the Nest (Nest Minion Rulebook page 5. or the plastic mini if you own the addon).
- if there are more than one, use one B(lue) dice and roll it (Rulebook 15.5). Roll until the icon is one of the opened Spawn Gate.
If there are no Spawn Gate or all closed and you dont have an istruction about to spawn it on the Active Hero location, on the 'B' letter location, etc., do not spawn any, skip the card.
I hope I was clear.

Oct 18, 2022 (edited) Full Date

Simone answered all questions except the Nest one. I reminded him about it and hope he answers it later. For now, here goes:
1) Whenever the game asks for a specific Fighting Style, a Hero who has two Styles can always choose the most favorable one.
2) We have no answer about Nests exploding twice yet.
3) If your eyes catch a secret paragraph, you gain its benefit if any.
4) Venoms and Nests drop Spirit tokens when they die (Mist hero ability)
5) Familiars cannot have the opposite alignment from their Hero. You have to redraw if this happens (or remove them from the deck before drawing randomly).
As you can see, it's a good thing asking for official clarifications because some answers are not what you'd expect.

Thanks for the answer. It was a Story card that said "if a drone is destroyed, remove one token from it".
We had the situation that one player lost his last basic unit in a district with two drones and were wondering whether those drones (that are lost according to the rules) count for the trigger.
Is the following correct?
- Kill and Sacrifice are the more specific triggers.
- Lost and Destroyed are the general ones.
- Hence, if something asks for "lost" or "destroyed" units, "killed" or "sacrificed" units will count.
- But if something asks for "killed" or "sacrificed" units, "destroyed" or "lost" units do not count.
- Furthermore, "sacrificed" units do not count as "killed" units and vice versa.
- Finally, "lost" units and "destroyed" units are the same thing.
I hope I got it right. Image: 🙂
Thanks for your help.
